method: sha256 of each tracked file's own sha256, path-sorted, concatenated and hashed again
command: find . -type f ! -path './.git/*' | sort | xargs -I{} sha256sum {} | sha256sum
note: All three trees hashed identical on 2026-09-18 and again verified for BOJI-017. Re-run the command above per tree and compare against tree_hash before any arm run.
